text:
॥ Om. According to the scriptures, the instruction is like that of Vamadeva. Om. 1/1/30.

I shall explain the scriptures. In the Bhagavata Purana it is said: “The supreme state is the scripture that is free from interruption.” In the Padma Purana it is said: “Vishnu is spoken of by His respective names, for He is the cause of all scriptures. There is no name anywhere that is more excellent than His name, O best of men.” Just as it is said: “I was Manu, and I was the Sun,” and so on. 30.
